reflections.lesson:
- The move was never confirmed into Recordings: in the folder picker the agent tapped an item by remembered index (18, previously DCIM) instead of reading labels, then left the picker without verifying the destination.
- In PickActivity, scroll to the "Recordings" folder, tap it so it is the open directory, then tap the "Move here" button at the bottom — the picker only closes after this confirm tap.
- Do not reuse tap indices from earlier screens; index 18 meant DCIM in FilesActivity but something else in the picker. Read each screen's visible labels before tapping.
- After the picker closes, verify: open the drawer → sdk_gphone_x86_64 → Recordings and confirm lecture_capture.mp3 is listed there before declaring complete.
- If the file is still in DCIM, redo: long-press the file → overflow menu → "Move to" → Recordings → "Move here".
- Always emit valid JSON actions; two unparsable replies wasted steps.

- The move was never verified: after the picker step, the agent wandered back through storage and declared "complete" without ever seeing lecture_capture.mp3 inside Recordings.
- In the PickActivity destination screen, tap the Recordings row so it opens and shows its (empty) contents — don't just highlight it — then tap the "MOVE" button at the bottom of the picker.
- If the picker's MOVE button is missing, the destination folder wasn't actually opened; scroll and tap into Recordings first.
- Before moving, confirm the long-press highlighted the row labeled lecture_capture.mp3 (check the selected item's name in the selection bar), not a neighboring file.
- After the move returns you to FilesActivity, navigate: storage root → sdk_gphone_x86_64 → Recordings, and only call status complete once the mp3 is visibly listed there.
